title: Blue & Gold Table Arch
desc: A rainbow-toned garden arch over pale blue sheers, with colourful aisle beds flanking wooden benches.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The rainbow mix crowning the arch and lining the aisle beds.

items.role: White hydrangea heads anchoring the arch clusters.
Violet-purple hydrangea through the arch centre.
Pink hydrangea warming the lower clusters.
White roses along the aisle beds (orange ranunculus tone in the scene is a logged gap — the warm orange comes from the spray roses).
Pink roses through the arch and ground mixes.
Purple larkspur spikes through the arch sides.
Yellow larkspur spikes adding bright verticals.
Orange multi-head spray roses brightening the lower clusters (closest orange multi-head rose).

groups.label: Fillers
groups.blurb: Small faces scattering through the rainbow planting.

items.role: Small purple daisies in the bed mixes (form-match small purple chrysanth types).
Yellow mini daisies — covers both the yellow mini daisies and small yellow filler blooms.
White mini daisies scattered through the beds.
Purple forget-me-not clusters weaving through the arch.

groups.label: Greenery & grasses
groups.blurb: The feathery green base of the whole scheme.

items.role: Dark green pine spray giving needle texture inside the mixes.
Airy plume grass covering the fountain grass and miscanthus plumes (form-match).
Fine soft trailing grasses over the arch edges.
Eucalyptus sprigs through the mid layer.

groups.label: Styling
groups.blurb: The drapes and furniture of the aisle.

items.role: Pure white milk-silk backdrop drape layered behind the pale blue sheers (pale blue sheer itself is a pending decision — see logged gap).
